messages:
maya: FYI helm upgrade for rwinference-gpupool v2.3 -> v2.4 aborted during post-upgrade hooks. saw a mix of hook lockfile + pod Pending because no GPU nodes available. deploy-bot: Failed hook: post-upgrade/validate-gpupool (timeout)
deploy-bot: release rwinference-gpupool v2.4 failed at 2026-03-17T18:13:20Z with status: hook failed
sam: Can you paste the hook pod logs and the helm output? Also did GitOps apply finish? :thinking_face:
maya: pastebin of helm output: https://paste.redwood.example/ab12

helm output snippet:
```
HOOKS FAILED: v1/Job "gpupool-postcheck" failed after 10m0s (failed containers: [validate])
Pod rwinference-gpupool-postcheck-xyz status: Pending
Events:
  Type     Reason              Age   From               Message
  ----     ------              ----  ----               -------
  Normal   Scheduled           9m    default-scheduler  pod scheduled on ip-10-0-22-45
  Warning  FailedScheduling    9m    kubescheduler      0/5 nodes are available: 3 node(s) didn't match node selector, 2 Insufficient gpu.
```

maya: hook logs show kubelet couldn't admit because pods require nvidia.com/gpu=1. No running GPU nodes in the cluster at that moment, scale-down history shows spot nodepool evictions minutes earlier.
liam: ugh, spot pool got a mass eviction from provider-side preemption. Autoscaler didn't spin up replacements because we hit regional quota on gpu vCPUs. I see terraform apply for nodepool-scale was blocked by a pending approval PR in infra-provisioning repo (lockfile: infra/locks/nodepool-scaling.lock) :facepalm:
ashley: that lockfile was left by a previous GitOps job that failed halfway (CI timeout). We should probably have a TTL cleanup for lockfiles. Right now ops-runbook requires manual unlock.
tess: so two separate failure modes: (1) hook expects GPU capacity during post-upgrade, (2) GitOps lockfile prevented nodepool scaling. Combined -> release aborted.
sam: can we hotfix to unblock the release asap? Options: remove the hook requirement (risky), manually create nodepool via cloud console, or patch the hook to tolerate zero GPUs and run a followup canary later.
liam: quick mitigation I did: created an emergency CPU-only Job variant and re-run helm with --no-hooks to finish CRD upgrades, then trigger the validation job later once GPUs are back. Command I ran:
```
# create temp job that bypasses gpu selector
kubectl apply -f jobs/validate-gpupool-cpu-bypass.yaml
helm upgrade --install rwinference-gpupool ./charts/gpupool --set skipPostHooks=true --no-hooks
```

maya: confirmed CRDs are upgraded and controllers reconciled. However this leaves the post-upgrade validation undone which we need to run ASAP.
ashley: I'll remove the stale lockfile from infra/locks/nodepool-scaling.lock after coordinating with PR owner @devops-team. Doing that now.
ashley: removed lockfile and kicked off terraform apply via pipeline (terraform-cloud). It queued a run and needs an approval from infra-owners. I pinged @infra-owners on the run.
tess: timeline estimate? we need GPUs back to run the real validation job.
ashley: terraform run started, plan shows +3 g4dn nodes in eu-west-1. Approver needed; pinged.
sam: once nodes are up, how do we run the original hook safely to avoid another failed helm? Can we run the hook manually against the upgraded release?
liam: yes. Once nodes are Ready we can run the job with kubectl create job --from=cronjob/... or run kubectl apply -f jobs/validate-gpupool.yaml --namespace release-ops and watch. Also recommend we mark the release as is_paused=true in our internal release tracker so alerting doesn't auto-rollback.
maya: agreed. I'll mark release paused, then run the real validation job manually. Also adding a quick patch to the hook job to increase toleration and back off retries to avoid hammering scheduler.
sam: postmortem action items drafted: 1) add TTL to GitOps lockfiles, 2) change helm post-upgrade hook to be resilient to transient capacity issues (don't block entire release), 3) add alert when nodepool utilization + pending pods with gpu > threshold, 4) consider temporary fallback model variant without GPUs for rollouts.
maya: thanks all - rolling followups. I'll update the release ticket with commands and timeline. cc @product if they want the short delay notice.
